name: Lucrovox
task: Someone — or an AI — to answer the calls we miss
summary: AI phone agent for local service businesses — answers missed calls, books jobs and captures leads 24/7 for trades like HVAC, plumbing and roofing.
best_for: local service businesses — HVAC, plumbing, roofing, med spas — losing revenue to missed calls who want a 24/7 AI receptionist that books jobs straight into Google Calendar, Housecall Pro, ServiceTitan or Jobber
skip_if: your call volume is tiny (100 Starter calls is the whole point) or your callers expect a human — ring their live demo line first and judge the voice yourself
honest_knock:
The meter is AI-handled calls: Starter’s 100 calls a month is roughly three a day, so a genuinely busy shop outgrows it quickly — and the steps are steep ($199 → $499 → $999). The ‘callers can’t tell it’s AI’ claim is the vendor’s own: they offer a live demo number, so test that before you commit.

One more thing to read carefully on the sibling product's page. LucroChat's ROI calculator reports its return “Based on Growth plan ($99/mo)”, while the plan table on the same page prices Growth at $59 a month (first read 24 August 2026, unchanged when we re-read it on 15 September 2026, and still there after the vendor told us that day it had been fixed). The $99 is the higher of the two, so nobody is being lured with a low number, but a page that quotes two different prices for one plan is a page whose figures you check at checkout rather than take on trust.

pricing.entry_price_terms: Starter · per month for up to 100 AI-handled calls, with a 14-day free trial
pricing.notes:
(re-verified 2026-09-15 on lucrovox.com/#pricing and lucrovox.com/lucrochat, both read in a real browser with the pages fully loaded) The phone agent has three published tiers and the plan table is back on the page: Starter $199 a month for up to 100 AI-handled calls, Pro $499 for up to 500 calls with CRM integration and advanced lead qualification, Enterprise $999 for up to 2,000 calls with white-label branding and multi-location support. Higher volume is quote-only. Starter and Pro carry a 14-day trial, Enterprise 30 days. On our previous reading, 17 August, the pricing page opened with a missed-call ROI calculator and the tier list could not be retrieved at all; it is worth knowing that the plan table on this site comes and goes, and that the calculator's outputs ($500 average job value producing $750 a week and $39,000 a year of lost revenue) are illustrations rather than prices.

LucroChat, the website chat product from the same vendor, sits on lucrovox.com/lucrochat with its own table metered on monthly conversations rather than calls: Starter $29 for up to 1,000 conversations on one website, Growth $59 for up to 3,000 conversations on up to three websites, Professional $199 for up to 10,000 conversations on unlimited websites, each with a 14-day trial and no card required. Its own FAQ agrees, describing pricing as starting at $29 a month for 1,000 conversations. One number on that page does not agree with the rest: the ROI calculator above the table reports its result “Based on Growth plan ($99/mo)” while the table prices Growth at $59. Read the plan table, not the calculator. LucroVox's partnerships team told us on 15 September 2026 that LucroChat had moved to $49, $99 and $249 and that the calculator now matches the table; we read both pages that same day and neither had happened. The table still prints $29, $59 and $199, the FAQ still says pricing starts at $29, and the calculator still reports $99. Those higher figures may well be where the product is heading, so if checkout quotes you $49, that is the vendor running ahead of its own pricing page. We publish what the page shows. Two products, two meters, one domain — price them separately.
